jobs.description: Mavericks Wanted   When was the last time you achieved the impossible? This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.     Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you re someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we ll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.   What You’ll Do You will report to the Senior Director, Market Access, EU Center and work closely with Medical Affairs, HEOR, Regulatory, Commercial and our global Market Access team to secure and sustain patient access to BridgeBio’s medicines across the DACH region. jobs.description: ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place. THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it. This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role: We are looking for Mid-Market Account Executives. This role is focused on selling into global mid-market businesses with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions. Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works. Our mid-market motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Embodied AI
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. We're a global organization who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes constantly, and our job is to create user-facing products supported by our best-in-class data, allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring maximal value to our customers. Apply advanced techniques including graph computation, statistical modeling, and machine learning to large-scale on-chain datasets. jobs.title: Data & IA Product Manager - H/F
jobs.description: On recrute des Product Managers pour construire des produits data et IA chez nos clients grands comptes, du dataset jusqu’à l’agent en production. 👋 Tu travailles sur des données propres et utiles, et sur des produits IA que les équipes utilisent vraiment au quotidien. 🎯 Tes missions Ton métier de PM, avant tout Tu mènes la discovery : entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins avec les métiers, tests d’hypothèses avant de lancer quoi que ce soit en dev Tu construis la roadmap, tu priorises et tu tiens un backlog à la fois fonctionnel et technique Tu rédiges les epics et les user stories, et tu fais avancer le delivery en agile avec ton équipe Tu suis l’impact de ce qui sort avec des OKR et des KPI, et tu ajustes en fonction Le volet data Tu construis des produits data : data platform, API, datasets partagés entre équipes, tableaux de bord que les métiers ouvrent tous les matins Tu vérifies que les données existent et qu’elles sont exploitables avant de lancer un cas d’usage Tu travailles au quotidien avec les data engineers et les data scientists, et tu sais lire et interpréter la donnée par toi-même Le volet IA Tu pilotes des produits IA : assistants, agents, recherche sur la documentation interne (RAG), modèles de prévision Tu fais équipe avec nos AI Engineers : tu comprends leurs contraintes et tu challenges leurs choix quand il faut Tu suis la performance des modèles et surtout leur adoption réelle par les utilisateurs Tu aides les métiers à comprendre ce que l’IA peut faire pour eux, et ce qu’elle ne fera pas Avec l’expérience, tu prends des sujets plus structurants, comme la stratégie produit, la gouvernance de la donnée ou le passage à l’échelle d’un pilote IA, et tu accompagnes les PM plus juniors. 🧭 Ton évolution Chez nous, ce sont tes résultats en mission qui font avancer ta carrière, jusqu’à un rôle de Lead si tu en as envie. Comme Hubvisory a aussi une practice d’AI Engineers et une practice Orga & Transfo, tu peux élargir ton périmètre sans change

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society. ✨ Our values Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. The role 🔍 One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right. You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports. This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution. The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo , our Chief Product

jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. About the Product Team You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team. The Role As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. jobs.description: Software Engineer, Research Platform About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. jobs.description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed. It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does. Key Responsibilities Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time. Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists. Keep accurate records of every interaction. Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved. jobs.description: We’re hiring an analyst to open first conversations with investors who are new to Pairs, and to book their meetings with the founders we work with. About Pairs Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most. The role You help grow the investor side of Pairs. From your first week you’re on calls with investors who are new to Pairs, learning what they invest in and why, and matching them with founders who fit. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, and VCs are still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You don’t need a network of US startup investors to start; we bring the investors to you and coach you on building relationships with them. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to people. Analysts who do well here move up to associate and run their own book of investors. jobs.description: Meet Yubico Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore. Why Join Our Mission? At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity , pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values: Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience. Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult. One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together. Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program , offering free open-source repositories , libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program. You ll oversee the end-to-end procurement operations process, optimise inventory and supplier performance, and continuously improve the systems and processes that keep our production running smoothly. Working cross-functionally with Planning, Production, Finance, Culinary, and Operations, you ll play a key role in ensuring the right products are available at the right time, while driving operational excellence and supporting Factor s continued growth. What you’ll do Lead and develop our Procurement Operations team, responsible for purchasing, supplier coordination, inventory management, and waste reduction. Own the end-to-end procurement operations process, ensuring ingredients and packaging are delivered On Time, In Full, and In Quality (OTIFQ) to support uninterrupted production. Drive inventory governance, ensuing product availability and operational efficiency while minimising waste and stock risk. Champion our zero-waste strategy through continuous optimisation of purchasing parameters, inventory controls, and forecasting inputs. Partner closely with Planning, Finance, Supply Chain, Culinary, and Production to optimize purchasing strategies and ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Monitor procurement KPIs, purchasing data, and system accuracy, using insights to identify trends, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational improvements. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and standardise procurement and inventory processes through data, technology, and continuous improvement initiatives. jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data. When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design. The work combines research and production engineering: The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers . The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints. Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you ll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. jobs.description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. jobs.title: Revenue Operations
jobs.description: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Intern
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads.

jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed

Als Logistiek Teamleider bij BERG ben jij een belangrijke schakel in onze logistieke operatie. Je stuurt dagelijks een team van Logistiek Medewerkers aan, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt ervoor dat de goederenstroom soepel, veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer, werkt waar nodig zelf mee en weet collega's op een positieve manier te begeleiden, motiveren en ontwikkelen. Je bent het aanspreekpunt op de werkvloer, houdt overzicht over de dagelijkse operatie en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat er moet gebeuren. You sit between hardware and software and keep both sides honest about timing, power and interfaces. jobs.title: Visiting Associate - 6-12 months
jobs.description: About First Momentum Ventures We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds , backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing. With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon , we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects. Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe . We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply . We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside. The Role As a Visiting Associate , you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates. This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup , land a full-time VC role , or start their own company down the road. Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup , or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe . jobs.title: Medical Writer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst mehr als bloß Texte schreiben? Du willst mit deiner medizinischen Expertise echten Impact schaffen und die Zukunft der medizinischen Kommunikation aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Als Innovation Hub treiben wir digitale Transformationen im Healthcare-Bereich voran und setzen Benchmarks in der Branche. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem ambitionierten Team erarbeitest du fundierte, zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Ärzte, Fachpersonal und Patienten, immer mit dem Anspruch, komplexe Themen verständlich und wirkungsvoll zu vermitteln. Dabei sollst du aktiv deine Ideen und Kreativität einbringen, um neue Impulse zu setzen, mit dem Ziel: wissenschaftliche Präzision, ein feines Gespür für die Zielgruppe und innovative Lösungen zu vereinen und so die Kommunikation im Healthcare-Bereich voranzutreiben. Aufgaben Medizinische Inhalte mit strategischem Impact – Du erstellst nicht nur fundierte Texte, sondern entwickelst gezielte Inhalte, die Ärzte, Fachpersonal und Patienten sowohl zu komplexen medizinischen Themen als auch bei praktischen Fragen abholen. Gamechanger statt Standard-Medical-Writing – Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst über klassische Formate hinaus. Ob interaktive Formate, Storytelling oder innovative digitale Wissensvermittlung – du hilfst dabei, medizinische Kommunikation auf das nächste Level zu heben. jobs.title: Werkstudent Copywriter
jobs.description: In een notendop Picnic is een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Europa. Als moderne melkboer maken we elke dag duizenden klanten blij met hun boodschappen. Dat doen we verser, goedkoper en groener dan anderen. Onze klanten doen boodschappen en plannen hun maaltijden in onze app en vervolgens bezorgen wij alles gratis thuis. Zonder omweg via de winkel, in elektrische autootjes, met een grote glimlach. Toch is onze website minstens zo belangrijk. Het is dé plek waar we nieuwe klanten naar de app trekken. En daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig! Als Copywriter Werkstudent schrijf je heldere, wil-ik-verder-lezen-webteksten: van pagina’s die onze diensten uitleggen tot tips-en-trickspagina’s en zo nu en dan wat SEO. De kunst van het vak Webcopy: Je schrijft teksten waar je zelf op zou doorklikken. Van pagina’s over onze diensten tot recepttips en inspirerende verhalen over onze makers. De juiste toon: Die weet jij wel te vinden. Want hallo, een tekst over paasrecepten vraagt om iets heel anders dan een verhaal over onze nieuwste appfunctie. Samenwerken: Je spart graag met collega’s, maar gaat net zo graag zelf op onderzoek uit. Samen maken jullie onze website steeds een beetje beter.  Blijven leren: Je leert van ervaren copywriters, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en ontdekt gaandeweg wat een webtekst écht goed maakt. Over jou... Je volgt een opleiding in bijvoorbeeld communicatie, journalistiek, media of creative writing. Je schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en wordt blij van taal, woorden en zinnen die precies kloppen. Spreek je ook nog ein bisschen Duits? Dat is een plus! Je vindt het leuk om langere teksten te schrijven en maakt complexe informatie graag behapbaar. Je hebt gevoel voor structuur: je weet hoe je een tekst logisch opbouwt en online prettig leesbaar maakt. Je hebt gevoel voor humor, al vind je het wat ongemakkelijk om dat over jezelf te zeggen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Picnic perks  🥗Verse

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Operations & Supply Chain
jobs.description: En bref   Chez Picnic, notre croissance opérationnelle en France s’accélère : plusieurs nouvelles zones logistiques sont prévues dès fin 2026 et début 2027. En tant que Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain & Opérations , tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques. Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic. Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité. Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus. Tes missions   Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs. Accompagner notre expansion en France : tu recrutes les profils clés qui permettront l’ouverture et le développement de nos nouveaux sites logistiques. Définir ta stratégie de recrutement : tu identifies les bons profils, marchés et canaux de sourcing, et adaptes ton approche en fonct

Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. jobs.title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. jobs.description: Het team en de functie Binnen ons Banking & Finance team werken we op dit moment met zeven advocaten. We begeleiden transacties, adviseren over financieel toezichtrecht en staan cliënten bij in procedures over onder andere zorgplicht en verhaal. Dat doen we voor banken, verzekeraars, fondsen, leasemaatschappijen, factoraars en grotere bedrijven. Samen met ons Herstructuring & Insolventie-team staan we ook bedrijven met een herstructureringsvraagstuk en hun stakeholders zijn. Ons team wordt erkend als toonaangevende praktijk in de internationale ranglijsten Legal500 en Chambers and Partners. In het afgelopen jaar heeft ons team voor meer dan EUR 8 miljard aan financieringen naar closing begeleid. Ter ondersteuning en uitbreiding van onze praktijk zijn we op zoek naar een juridisch medewerker en/of beginnend advocaat-stagiair. Als juridisch medewerker begin je in eerste instantie op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar de functie van advocaat-stagiaire. De functie is opgezet voor een periode van twee tot vier maanden, afhankelijk van het mogelijke startmoment van de beroepsopleiding. Als advocaat-stagiaire streven we ernaar om je op te leiden tot een succesvolle advocaat. Je krijgt onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's snel verantwoordelijkheden en speelt een zelfstandige rol in dossiers. In jouw functie ben je bezig met het coördineren van transacties, het opstellen van besluiten, zekerheden, leningsovereenkomsten en andere transactiedocumenten en het adviseren op het gebied van financiering en zekerheden. Je hebt veel interactie met cliënten en andere adviseurs. De transactiepraktijk is internationaal en altijd in beweging. Daarom werk je altijd samen met onze ervaren advocaten, die je ondersteunen in je ontwikkeling. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. jobs.description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As a Data Science Extern at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? BetterHelp is looking for a Data Science Extern to help us scale and increase our impact. You will use data to drive insight into the product and business. The ideal candidate would have experience/exposure to analyzing large and complex data sets related to web products. You'll be doing plenty of data wrangling and post-hoc analysis, both to support product improvements, marketing efficiency, and business decisions. What will you do? Language Model Optimization: Engage in the refinement and enhancement of language models, including fine-tuning and retraining to meet specific requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively collaborate with the product and development teams to conceptualize and design effective machine learning models and algorithms

jobs.description: The Learning Team at ClickHouse is growing fast as more users discover the power of ClickHouse and seek to understand how to use it effectively. As a Training Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating, managing, and supporting the logistics and administration of global training programs, with a focus on public and private instructor-led training events. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless event execution and a consistent, high-quality learner experience. What you will be doing: Here is a list of the typical tasks you would be performing as a Training Operations Specialist: Schedule and organize virtual and in-person training events, including registration page setup, Zoom configuration, and email communications. Coordinate training event logistics, including sourcing and booking venues, managing event requirements, coordinating instructor availability, and communicating with instructors and attendees. Manage event registration, monitor enrollment, send reminders, follow-up emails, and track attendance to ensure smooth event execution. Track and report training metrics, registration trends, attendance, and program outcomes to key stakeholders. Partner with Field Marketing teams to coordinate public training events, including event scheduling, registration monitoring, and promotional support. Collaborate with Sales teams to coordinate private training requests, manage scheduling and logistics, and support customer training needs. Work closely with the broader Training team to coordinate resources, streamline processes, and ensure consistent execution across training programs. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in training coordination, operations, event management, or a related role. Proficiency with marketing automation platforms, particularly Marketo, including registration management and email communications. jobs.title: Jr Account Executive
jobs.description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.
